title: Boy's Abyss
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Reiji Kurose feels trapped in his rural hometown with his family. When idol Nagi Aoe, working at a convenience store, tells him of the 'Lover's Abyss' where couples die together, the two attempt suicide and fail; his teacher Yuri Shibasawa rescues him and becomes entangled with him, as do other adults and friends.
life_message: It holds up escape from suffocating ties as the longed-for good, while showing how hard escape is.
